title: Reverse Linked List II
summary: Reverse only the nodes from position left to position right of a linked list, in one pass.

tests.explain: Positions 2 to 4 hold 2, 3, 4. Reversed they read 4, 3, 2; nodes 1 and 5 stay where they are.
A one-node segment is already reversed.
The segment is the whole list, and the head changes.

hints: You need the node just before position left, so you can reconnect the reversed part. A dummy node before the head covers left = 1.
Walk left - 1 steps from the dummy to reach that node, called before. The node after it becomes the tail of the reversed part.
Reverse right - left + 1 nodes with prev/curr/next, then reconnect: before.next.next = curr (the node after the segment) and before.next = prev (the new front).

complexity.time: O(n): at most one walk to the segment plus one pass over it
complexity.space: O(1): a few pointers and a dummy node
